import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Define features (all columns except Id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Split training data into train and validation (hold-out split)
val_size = int(0.1 * len(train_df))
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].iloc[:-val_size]
y_train_raw = train_df[target_col].iloc[:-val_size]
X_val = train_df[feature_cols].iloc[-val_size:]
y_val_raw = train_df[target_col].iloc[-val_size:]
val_ids = train_df[id_col].iloc[-val_size:]

num_classes = train_df[target_col].nunique()

# CRITICAL FIX: Convert labels from 1-indexed [1..7] to 0-indexed [0..6] for LightGBM
y_train = y_train_raw - 1
y_val_pred_label = None  # Will store predictions in original 1-indexed scale

print(f"Number of classes: {num_classes}")
print(f"Label range after conversion: [{y_train.min()}, {y_train.max()}]")

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

print(f"Feature count: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(
    f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}, Test samples: {len(X_test)}"
)

# Optimized hyperparameters for faster training
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 20,
    "max_depth": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 50,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, verbose=-1)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_raw - 1, reference=train_data, verbose=-1)

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=100)],
    feature_fraction_seed=RANDOM_STATE,
    seed=RANDOM_STATE,
)

best_iteration = model.best_iteration
print(f"Best iteration: {best_iteration}")

print("Making predictions...")
# Get predictions
predictions_val = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=best_iteration)
predictions_test = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=best_iteration)


# Convert multi-class probabilities to class labels (back to 1-indexed)
def get_predictions_proba_array(pred):
    return np.argmax(pred, axis=1) + 1  # Add 1 back to match original label scale


y_val_pred = get_predictions_proba_array(predictions_val)
y_test_pred = get_predictions_proba_array(predictions_test)

# Calculate validation accuracy on hold-out (never trained on)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_raw, y_val_pred)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Save submission file
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(submission_path), exist_ok=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids.values, target_col: y_test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to: {submission_path}")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Sample predictions:")
print(submission_df.head())
